subject.title: fix(auth): allow OpenAI OAuth for audio transcription

question: Should native OpenAI `api.openai.com` batch audio transcription officially support ChatGPT/Codex OAuth bearer credentials, rather than remain API-key-only?
rationale: The implementation deliberately expands an auth-provider contract that was previously made API-key-only; source and tests can bound the mechanics, but they cannot decide the durable supported-product policy.

options.title: Accept native OAuth-backed batch STT
options.body: Approve OAuth only for the tested native endpoint, require an exact-head redacted live run, and align the OpenAI provider documentation before merge.

options.title: Keep batch STT API-key-only
options.body: Reject this restored OAuth route and retain the existing fail-closed behavior with clear validation or migration guidance for OAuth-profile audio configurations.

recommendation.title: Accept native OAuth-backed batch STT
recommendation.body: Approve OAuth only for the tested native endpoint, require an exact-head redacted live run, and align the OpenAI provider documentation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the API-key-only OpenAI audio-auth policy that this PR would intentionally revise.
